Game Overview

Drunken Duel is a two-player title where step into the chaotic world of Drunken Duel, where hilarious physics-based gunfights meet vibrant wild west visuals. Control a ragdoll stickman with single-button chaos, making each victory a test of timing and mastery. Unpredictable shots and amusing sounds make every duel an exhilarating challenge.
